obligations.body: 182001 defines a relation R:A->B as total and single-valued on A, with every represented R(x,y) lying in the declared A/B carriers.
182002 defines a relation R:A×B->C as total and single-valued on A×B, with every represented R(x,y,z) lying in the declared carriers.
182003 requires ADD and MUL to be total single-valued C×C->C, NEG to be total single-valued C->C, and ZERO/ONE to be members of C.
182003 requires ZERO != ONE.
For every a in C, a+0=0+a=a and a*1=1*a=a.
For every a in C, NEG(a)=na implies a+na=na+a=0.
For every nonzero a in C, an inverse ia exists in C with a*ia=ia*a=1.

Every represented INV(a,ia) requires a and ia in C and a != 0; the candidate's nested single-valued witness clause prevents two represented inverse outputs for the same nonzero input within the encoded scope.
For all a,b in C, represented sums a+b and b+a are equal.
For all a,b in C, represented products a*b and b*a are equal.
For all a,b,c in C, (a+b)+c = a+(b+c).
For all a,b,c in C, (a*b)*c = a*(b*c).
For all a,b,c in C, a*(b+c) = a*b + a*c.
182004 requires VADD:V×V->V, VNEG:V->V, SCALE:C×V->V to be total single-valued and VZERO to be a member of V.
For every v in V, v+VZERO=VZERO+v=v.
For every v in V, VNEG(v)=nv implies v+nv=nv+v=VZERO.
For all u,v in V, u+v=v+u.
For all u,v,w in V, (u+v)+w=u+(v+w).
For all a in C and u,v in V, a*(u+v)=a*u+a*v.
For all a,b in C and v in V, (a+b)*v=a*v+b*v.
For all a,b in C and v in V, (a*b)*v=a*(b*v).
For every v in V, 1*v=v.
No order, positivity, basis, dimension, linear-map, bilinear-algebra, composition-algebra, anti-involution, triality, reflection, or cross-track semantics are part of this module candidate.

closure_rule: Qualification must reconstruct all 23 obligations from the exact candidate and must reject any implementation/model violating an in-scope obligation. No extra field/vector theorem is promoted merely because it follows mathematically.
